Field.name: m
Field.usage: Maximum number of slices to be corrected per chunk
Field.manpage: Set the number of views to be processed per chunk to the given value (the default is 5 ).

Field.name: b
Field.usage: Number of boundary pixels for direct writing
Field.manpage: Number of pixels at each boundary between chunks to save in separate boundary files (named setname-nnn.cbound) and rewrite to the output file in the -finish.com file. The default is 2048.

Field.name: InitialComNumber
Field.manpage: Initial command file number to use, instead of starting with a "-start.com" file then files numbered from 1.

Field.name: OpenForMoreComs
Field.usage: Leave command file set open, finish with -sync instead of -finish
Field.manpage: Leave the command file collection open for more files by finishing with a "-sync.com" file instead of a "-finish.com" file and not removing command and log files.

Field.name: RootNameOfOutput
Field.usage: Root name for output command files
Field.manpage: Root name for command files, instead of using the name of the input command file.

Field.name: DirectoryForOutput
Field.usage: Directory in which to place output command files
Field.manpage: Directory in which to place output command files; log files will be created there as well. The command files must still be run from the data set directory.

Field.name: UniqueInfoFile
Field.usage: Attach the first command file number to a boundary info file
Field.manpage: Give unique numbers to boundary info files by attaching the first command file number to the boundary info file.

Field.name: InputDimensions
Field.usage: Size of expected image input file in X, Y, and Z
Field.manpage: Size the input image file in X, Y, and Z. Provide this if the file does not exist yet, to prevent the program from trying to access it.
